lines.2: 「I ran into some guys at the station I used to fight with.」
lines.3: 「They dropped their eyes and ran off, though.」
lines.5: 「I'd hate to get stabbed out of nowhere over some old grudge.」
lines.6: 「Still, between Konoe and everything else, my past sure has been coming after me lately.」
lines.7: 「My past is nothing but memories of getting rejected by girls.」
lines.8: 「If a girl dumps you by saying your very existence is disgusting, there ought to be a law that says murder is justified.」
lines.9: 「What, psychological self-defense? I think you'd have a hard time getting that law passed.」
lines.11: I looked up at the sky through the window.
lines.13: Come to think of it, the two of us used to look at the moon together a lot.
